subject: Grading-honesty sweep: code-house Armory (~20 modules) + dark-arts Linux labs (~5)
description: Extend the LM-1/#79 grading-honesty methodology to LinuxTerminal-based labs outside linux-mastery. Discovered 2026-07-11 (task #72 hunt): of 131 such labs, 26 call completeTask/completeChallenge with NO lt-error/ok guard. Armory (arm-bash-01..10, arm-sql-01..10) gates purely on cmdLine.includes() command-text, not success — e.g. arm-bash-01:514 `chmod +x` completes even against a nonexistent file (same class as lm-39). Also check 5 dark-arts da-linux-* labs (log-analysis, compromised-server, hidden-files, permission-analysis) for command-regex looseness. NUANCE: apply LM-1 practice-intent judgment per module (beginner intro modules may gate on command-shape intentionally; LM-1 excluded lm-53 tour, flagged lm-20/34). APPROACH: reuse LM-1 task-shape catalog + `ok = !output.includes('lt-error')` + puppeteer honesty probes + per-file harness (see _tools/ai900-ch01-honest-button-test.js). Nancy per file-family, Chris, deploy per-file. Detail in marathon backlog + scratchpad/task72-dishonest-buttons.md. Needs per-module ok-wiring (modules don't currently compute ok).
